status: Exploratory post-outcome lexical repair; original outcomes and external critique already observed
scope: All original searched patterns of motivating W233/W151, W231/W151 and W204/W540 refinements; semantic comparison anchors receive dictionary-productivity stress tests without asserted phonetic windows.

models.literal: Concatenate original full SLP1 components unchanged; residual length 1..6 SLP1 letters and at least one vowel. Preserve literal attestation and support.
models.limited_join: At every component boundary, retain the literal join and optionally apply only: final m before a consonant -> anusvara M or the corresponding stop-row nasal; a/A + a/A -> A; i/I before a heterogeneous vowel -> y; i/I + i/I -> I. Apply the same boundary rules to all rivals. No aspiration, voicing, retroflexion, consonant deletion, morphological stems, arbitrary edit distance or global phonological normalization.
models.sam_specific: Anusvara option is permitted before consonants; homorganic options are N for kKgGN, Y for cCjJY, R for wWqQR, n for tTdDn and m for pPbBm. A forward join must reproduce an exact dictionary headword.
models.inverse_scope: Generate underlying residual candidates only by inversion of the stated finite boundary rules; forward-verify every recovered candidate. No claim of full Sanskrit sandhi coverage.

rank_metrics: For each code and model, union all recovered residual candidates across its original searched patterns, count pattern-level support once, rank descending with ties retained, report selected rank, tie count and support histogram. Score ALL rivals; publish only top 20 bounded residuals and aggregates. Complete rankings/windows stay local.
crosswalk_sensitivity: Select Bonta Table18 source rows whose frozen first and second Wells candidate sets are both nonempty and disjoint. Mark disputed imported codes from the first mapping used by import_seeds. Exclude any original pattern containing a disputed code anywhere, including the proposed residual code, and recompute support/ranking/intersection. Report zero-pattern frames as undefined intersections.
productivity: Generic two-component dictionary joins [? + anchor] and [anchor + ?], literal and limited-join models, same residual bound 1..6 SLP1 letters with a vowel. These comparisons stress lexical flexibility; no new Sanskrit sound is assigned to a sign.

controls.type: Uniform samples without replacement from distinct alphabetic MW headwords of identical SLP1 length to each tested anchor stem; reused sample for each length across anchors/orientations/models.
controls.rng: Python random.Random independent of positional permutations and earlier run RNG; earlier sampled controls were not persisted as identities.

public_storage: Aggregates, top bounded headword/residual rivals, exact dictionary entry/page identifiers, source hashes, protocol, code hash and authored summary. No full source definition or complete corpus window strings.
local_storage: data/raw/2026-10-11-bonta-adversarial/lexical-diagnostics-v3/ for complete search windows, ranks and witnesses.
nonoverwrite: Refuse any existing public result or local directory; preserve all earlier outputs.
